summary: Part 2 of 4 of "7.0 Refund policy (Seller)" (03:41-06:52) covers the seller clock. Revibe's app slide shows which claim stages run the seller's clock in Saudi (SA) versus AE, ZA and other markets. It explains why the SA clock starts on day 1 (the AWB), says the courier choice is the seller's, shows how to raise a resolution request to freeze the clock, and shows the claims-list colour markers that flag claims at risk. The pack ends mid-sentence at 06:48. All 40 frames were opened (t00221 to t00404).
